shared_state.scope: Existing shared-state controls run in each release/runtime pair. Admitted arithmetic proofs contain no UDF.

released_arithmetic_implementation.contract: Each DECIMAL-only +, - or * node retains its resolved precision/scale and overflow NULL. ABS transforms the unscaled coefficient without floating conversion. Recursive ABS and same-scale precision widening preserve the contract. Division, remainder, rescaling, narrowing, mixed numeric operands and unverified producers retain generated evaluation.

projection_default_regressions.scope: NOT NULL character, BOOLEAN, integer and approximate numeric final projections retain their released generated value/default/NULL-flag contract. Nullable and WHERE consumers retain NULL; direct DECIMAL ERROR/DROP enforcement remains intact. These mixed correctness paths are not claimed as JVM-free acceleration.

method.build: release/default features/mimalloc; Oracle JDK 17.0.12; Apple M4 Pro; one thread
method.prepared_boundary: Released generated Java on prepared GenericRowData/BinaryRowData versus production Calc on matching Arrow. Operation and equivalent BOOLEAN/NULL consumption timed inside Rust for native execution and in Java for stock. Initial JNI/C Data import/export and perimeter transposes excluded; intrinsic previous JVM callbacks remain inside timing.
method.controls: Actual independently recompiled preceding encoder and retained preceding executable/DSO bind their real generated ABS evaluator. Candidate requires empty descriptors and intended native function work. Baseline includes the independent projection-default correctness repair.
method.data: DECIMAL(18,2)/(38,18) signed extrema and large coefficients, nullable/NOT NULL schemas, NULL every seven rows only for nullable input. ABS(v+v), ABS(v*v) and ABS((v+v)*v), each consumed by >0 OR CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN). The nullable consumer retains overflow NULL even for NOT NULL inputs. This measures arithmetic ABS through a BOOLEAN consumer, not final DECIMAL output timing. 1024-row bulk and 16-row multiplication controls.
method.order: Serial paired processes, 16 warmups/nine measurements, 131072 rows/trial, matching checksums and equivalent consumption.
method.pipeline: Million-row nullable DECIMAL(18,2) addition and DECIMAL(38,18) multiplication/nested producers with the same BOOLEAN consumers. Rowwise source/blackhole, parallelism one, two warmups/five measurements. Planning/startup, source generation, production JNI and both transposes retained. Require consumed NativeCalc, no fallback and empty candidate descriptors; actual previous path retains generated evaluators.
method.allocation: Untimed CountingAllocator wrapping System with malloc=mi_malloc/free=sf_free aliases. JVM/C++/other-thread allocations excluded; counting disabled during timed trials. Requested bytes and output buffers are distinct quantities.

profile.case: DECIMAL(18,2), nullable, ABS((v+v)*v)>0 OR CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN)
profile.scope: Initial native implementation; paired stock/native diagnostic. Stack counts identify dispatch/allocation work, not elapsed-time shares. Profiled elapsed times are excluded from qualification.
